generationPromptZh: 一个带加长条状座面及框式靠背的四脚长凳。它由长座面、后侧框式靠背和四脚组成。腿宽约为框宽的0.14倍，四脚向上面连接承重框。宽深比约2.10，高/最大水平跨度约0.90；支脚分置承重框四角，横向腿隙与框宽比0.62。实测采用3种不透明颜色，座框以棕色为主，座条呈浅棕色。座条2块。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.55, "category": "bench", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "depth": 12.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "height": 10.0, "instance": 0, "lipOverhang": 0.6, "neckFraction": 0.42, "ordinal": 43806, "redesign": 0, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.58, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 24.0}
generationPromptEn: A four leg bench with a long slatted seat and framed backrest. It includes a long seat, rear framed backrest and four legs. Legs are 0.14 frame-widths thick and connect upward to the frame. Width/depth is 2.10; height/horizontal-span is 0.90. The supports occupy four separated corner positions. Leg-gap/width is 0.62. Across 3 opaque colors, the frame is mainly brown and the seat is tan. There are 2 seat boards. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
